mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.7% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.7%, or the Rank IC is negative over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a sharp contraction in consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when both HOUST and RSAFS decline but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction effect is not significant (p>0.05) in a 2-year rolling regression.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle economic expansions, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 signals a supply-side shock that disrupts corporate margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO falls below 110.0 during late-cycle expansions, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the core CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 208.0 over the past month signals persistent inflation, which leads to delayed monetary tightening and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 208.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1500.0 thousand units in a month, it signals strong consumer confidence and rising demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1500.0, or the Rank IC is negative over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decreases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate a tight labor market that fuels wage inflation, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days due to expected monetary tightening.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term is not significant (p>0.05) in a 2-year rolling regression.

mechanism_narrative: During early-cycle expansions, a rise in retail sales (RSAFS) above 375000 million dollars signals robust consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS exceeds 375000 during early-cycle expansions, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year window.
